subject: Launch: Renewal Activation — Stakeholder Roster, Risks, and QBR Options
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratuslabs.com>, Brian O'Neill <brian.oneill@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch: Renewal Activation — Stakeholder Roster, Risks, and QBR Options

Hi Alyssa / Brian —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our renewal cadence, I want to kick off the activation plan for your upcoming term change and the planned burst capacity increase. Goal here is to line up stakeholders, call out any gating items, and lock a QBR window so execs can approve the change.

High-level ask: can we get a 30–45m QBR in the week of June 10–14? We can present the staffing and latency SLAs for the burst lanes and the commercial amendment.

Proposed kickoff agenda (keeps to 30 mins):
- Milestones & timeline (commit, staging, cutover)
- Stakeholder Roster (who owns procurement/legal/infra)
- Risks & gating items (SLA exceptions, data residency, audit logs)
- Next steps & owner assignments

Immediate items from our side:
- Draft Mutual Action Plan attached (Mutual Action Plan v1.xlsx)
- A first-pass amendment for the term uplift will be routed to legal next week

Please reply with: (1) who from your procurement/legal team we should loop in, and (2) two preferred 30–45m slots in the week of Jun 10–14.

Thanks — happy to coordinate the calendar.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratuslabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Brian O'Neill <brian.oneill@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: Renewal Activation — Stakeholder Roster, Risks, and QBR Options

Connor — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. Quick answers:

1) Procurement/legal: looping in our procurement alias (procurement@stratuslabs.com) and Brian O'Neill (cc'd) will shepherd legal redlines. Expect procurement to want the amendment and an SDSA for our compliance team.

2) QBR availability: Jun 11 (Tue) 10:00–10:45 PT or Jun 13 (Thu) 13:00–13:45 PT work best for us. Prefer the Jun 11 slot if it helps move approvals.

Potential gating items from our side:
- Confirmation of required audit-log retention policy (we currently store 90 days; security may request 1 year)
- Any changes to token residency or VPC setup for the burst lanes

I copied our operations lead, Brian — he'll surface infra constraints if any.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratuslabs.com>, Brian O'Neill <brian.oneill@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 May 2029 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: Renewal Activation — Stakeholder Roster, Risks, and QBR Options

Adding a couple of commercial notes before we lock the QBR:

- We can support the burst lanes as an interim canary (+20% guaranteed throughput) with a staged commit to full burst (+60%) assuming the performance checks pass in staging. That means two line items on the amendment: 1) term uplift and 2) staged capacity ramp with explicit acceptance tests.
- I attached a draft amendment (Amendment_draft_v2.pdf) that aligns to the MAP and includes the acceptance criteria we run in staging. Please treat as working copy — legal will redline.

If Jun 11 10:00 PT works for Stratus, I'll block the slot and prepare a short commercial slide (3 slides) that calls out pricing for the canary and the full ramp.

Risks to flag for the QBR:
- Any regulatory hold that requires log retention beyond 180 days will affect cost modeling
- If the VPC peering requires a dedicated private deployment path, lead time is typically 3–4 weeks; we should surface that now

On a logistics note — I left a DocuSign placeholder in our internal doc; once legal confirms, we can push the amendment through the DocuSign link below.

Attachment: amendment_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
Related links: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stratuslabs.com>, Brian O'Neill <brian.oneill@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, procurement@stratuslabs.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: Renewal Activation — Stakeholder Roster, Risks, and QBR Options

Alyssa / Brian — great, Jun 11 10:00–10:45 PT is confirmed on our side. I've sent a calendar invite and included the draft MAP + amendment as pre-reads.

Actions going into the QBR:
- Connor: present timeline + roles, call out lead times for VPC peering and log retention impacts
- Karthik: commercial slide and acceptance criteria for canary + full ramp
- Naomi: post-sales staffing plan and on-call handover (Naomi will join the QBR)
- Irene: coordinate legal path for the amendment and track redlines
- Stratus procurement: please review Amendment_draft_v2.pdf and return any high-level constraints by May 24 so we can incorporate them prior to QBR

If anything else pops up please flag, otherwise we will run the QBR as scheduled and target a signed amendment by end of June (timeline depends on procurement).

Thanks all — Connor
